extraction.title: Add Groups resource type and scopes to authorization schema
extraction.head: feature-groups-authz-implementation

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as adding GROUPS_RESOURCE_TYPE and V2 group/user permission classes in Keycloak's FGAP v2 schema. Confidence score 3/5. Flags a critical bug: AdminPermissionsSchema.getResourceName() does not handle the new Groups resource type, which could cause runtime exceptions. Also notes a double semicolon in the test file and an empty-set return when all groups should be accessible.
The Javadoc for the method says it returns a Stream of group IDs, but the signature returns Set<String>. Suggests changing the @return text to describe a Set.
The field declaration for topGroup ends with a double semicolon, which is a syntax error. Suggests removing one semicolon.
The Javadoc line mentioning AdminPermissionsSchema#MANAGE is missing a space after the word 'or'. Suggests a whitespace fix.
Same missing-space-after-'or' Javadoc comment as the previous one, repeated on a second thread for the same file.
getGroupIdsWithViewPermission() returns an empty set when users can view all groups globally. It should return all group IDs instead.
canManage() checks both the VIEW and MANAGE scopes, but it should check only the MANAGE scope.

extraction.notes: The summary mentions a getResourceName() bug but no inline comment on that file appears. The UserPermissionEvaluator missing-space comment appears twice as separate threads.
